adm.title: Admission Requirements, Engineering (PDF) | RIT Dubai
quotes: British Required Scores Minimum 5 IGCSE (C’s or above) and 2 As or 1 A level (D’s or above) Math, Physics and 1 of Chemistry/Biology minimum grade C or above in IGCSE or in AS/A Level Completion of Grade 12/ Year 13 Minimum average 80%
International Baccalaureate Required Scores Minimum 28 points Math, Physics and 1 of Chemistry/Biology minimum grade is 4 or above
Engineering students must appear for Math and physics placement tests prior to course registration.

admissions.threshold: BS Electrical Engineering: British system: at least 5 IGCSEs (C or above) and 2 AS-Levels or 1 A-Level (D or above), with Maths, Physics and Chemistry or Biology at grade C or above (IGCSE or AS/A Level), Year 13 completed, minimum average 80%. Maths and physics placement tests. Meeting the minimum doesn't guarantee direct admission.

english.min_score: Full admission: Academic IELTS overall 6.5 and above, TOEFL iBT 79 and above, TOEFL ITP 550 and above, or EmSAT English 1550 and above. Conditional admission: IELTS 5.0 - 6.0, TOEFL iBT 61 - 78, TOEFL ITP 500 - 547, EmSAT 1100 - 1525.
english.notes: Students in English-medium international curricula may qualify for an exemption.
